properties.label: Fixed-pose material study
properties.text: Place one sculptural folded-aperture object in a quiet warm-gray studio with a large editorial headline and compact Ceramic/Metal/Glass selector. Keep geometry, camera and silhouette constant across the study.

properties.label: Shared folded aperture
properties.text: Use one folded-aperture geometry with distinct face, bevel and side readings for every material state.

properties.label: Ceramic, metal and refracting glass
properties.text: Give ivory ceramic a fine speckled fired body and quiet dielectric sheen; give satin metal directional reflection gradients and fine brushing; make clear glass refract the actual typographic backing plane. Avoid blacked-out metal faces and uniformly opaque-looking glass.

properties.label: Same-pose material selection
properties.text: Selection changes the actual material without moving the object or rebuilding the page. Load the detailed model once, dispose it on departure and provide matching posters for all three choices.

properties.label: Same-pose material comparison
properties.text: Compare all three states at the same pose, in the full composition and at actual-size detail.

properties.label: Distinct material evidence
properties.text: Show transmitted background evidence in glass, directional reflection structure in metal and a distinct opaque ceramic body. Verify that surface detail survives filtering at the delivered DPR.

properties.label: GLB and fallback parity
properties.text: Inspect the GLB in the same lighting as its procedural source and export matching fallback states for all materials.
